Reasoning: The question asks “which organ is the small, pear-shaped muscular sac located below the right lobe of the liver”. In the image, the corresponding small sac-like structure near below the liver is labeled Gallbladder; anatomically, this description also corresponds to the gallbladder. Therefore the answer is gallbladder.
